title: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Sit tall on a sturdy chair or bench with feet planted.
Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height with wrists stacked over elbows.
Press the weights upward until your arms are long without forcing the elbows hard straight.
Lower slowly to shoulder height and repeat with control.
form_cues: Keep ribs down rather than leaning back to finish the rep.
Stop if pressing overhead causes sharp shoulder pain.
regressions: Press one arm at a time with the other hand lightly supporting the bench.
progressions: Increase load gradually after all reps are smooth.
Use a slower three-second lowering phase.

title: Supported split squat
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance beside a wall or sturdy support.
Keep most of your weight through the front foot and lightly hold the support for balance.
Lower both knees a comfortable distance while keeping the front foot planted.
Push through the front foot to return to standing, finish the set, then swap sides.
form_cues: Keep the front knee tracking in the same direction as the toes.
Use a shorter range if balance or knee comfort limits depth.
regressions: Use a shallower range of motion.
progressions: Hold a light dumbbell in the free hand.

title: Resistance-band face pull
instructions: Anchor a resistance band securely at about face height.
Hold the band with both hands, step back until there is light tension and stand tall.
Pull your hands towards either side of your face while your elbows travel back and slightly out.
Return slowly until your arms are long without losing control of the band.
form_cues: Keep shoulders away from your ears.
Use a light enough band that you do not lean backwards to finish the rep.
progressions: Step slightly farther from the anchor.
Pause for one second in the pulled position.

title: Machine chest press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles sit around mid-chest height and choose a manageable weight.
Sit back with feet planted and hold the handles with wrists straight.
Press the handles forward until your arms are long without locking hard.
Return slowly until you feel a comfortable stretch across the chest and shoulders.
form_cues: Keep your back against the pad instead of arching to move the weight.
Keep elbows in a comfortable angle rather than flaring them excessively.
progressions: Increase the weight gradually once all reps are controlled.
Add one or two reps per set before increasing load.

title: Dumbbell farmer carry
instructions: Stand between two dumbbells, pick them up safely and stand tall with one in each hand.
Walk at a controlled pace while keeping your head up and shoulders relaxed.
Turn carefully using several small steps rather than twisting sharply.
Set the dumbbells down under control at the end of each carry and rest before repeating.
form_cues: Keep the weights close to your sides and avoid leaning to either side.
Choose a route free of trip hazards before you start.
regressions: Carry for a shorter time or use one weight with the free hand lightly supported.
progressions: Increase weight while keeping posture and walking speed controlled.

title: Exercise bike steady intervals
instructions: Set the bike so you can pedal comfortably without rocking your hips.
Warm up for two minutes at an easy pace.
Alternate one minute at a purposeful effort with one minute easy, keeping the resistance controlled.
Finish with two easy minutes and let your breathing settle before getting off the bike.
form_cues: Keep the effort controlled enough that you could still speak a short sentence.
Avoid using resistance so heavy that your hips rock from side to side.
regressions: Ride continuously at an easy steady pace.
progressions: Add one interval before increasing resistance.
Increase resistance slightly while keeping cadence smooth.

title: Bird dog
instructions: Start on all fours with hands below shoulders and knees below hips.
Brace gently, then reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back without shifting your trunk.
Pause briefly while keeping your hips level.
Return under control and repeat on the other side.
form_cues: Reach long rather than lifting the hand or foot as high as possible.
Keep your lower back quiet and hips facing the floor.
regressions: Move only one arm at a time.
Move only one leg at a time.
progressions: Pause for three seconds in the extended position.
Perform with a slower controlled tempo.

title: Supported standing calf raise
instructions: Stand tall behind a sturdy chair or beside a wall and use light fingertip support.
Keep your knees soft and rise onto the balls of both feet.
Pause briefly at the top without rolling onto the outside of your feet.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor and repeat.
form_cues: Keep your weight evenly spread across the big-toe and little-toe side of each foot.
Use the support for balance rather than pulling yourself upward.
regressions: Use a smaller range of motion.
Perform the movement seated with feet flat, lifting the heels.
progressions: Perform more reps before adding load.
Hold light dumbbells once balance is reliable.
